notes.text: English: This handwritten leaf continues a discussion of local inertia groups and their proposed independence from the model X. It defines the stratum D_J^* by I(x)=J, writes the closed intersection as Delta_J, and asserts regularity and codimension d=card J, allowing the empty set. Hypotheses on the divisors are not restated here and their geometric sufficiency was not checked.

English: The marginal note says to define D_J as a sous-schéma by the intersection, then defines its uncertain underlined support/sous-ouvert by the visibly written equality I(x)=J. Conditional on I(x) meaning the set of divisor indices through x, the support of the full intersection is I(x) containing J, whereas equality removes points on extra divisors. This is a set-membership diagnostic only. Equality is retained as ink; the uncertain underlined noun may affect the intended reading. No theorem of regularity or model independence has been proved here.

English: The only written (36) occurs inside the diagonal marginal sentence, immediately after its intersection expression. There is no independently written equation number at the main display. The bottom-left thin numeral 131 is retained as a foliation margin entry; its hand has not been attributed to the author.
